review_comment: I don't know the code base well but is it possible for the nested objects to be null too? Or only the result of `getIndexer()`?

Only the result of `getIndexer()`:
- indexer verifies that [config](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/transform/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/transform/transforms/TransformIndexer.java#L160) is non null
- [destination](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/core/transform/transforms/TransformConfig.java#L230) does too
- [index](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/core/transform/transforms/DestConfig.java#L60) does too
